# Real Data Experiments

Use target data to test the actual research question under real-world constraints. This
directory is always present, including projects that begin with real data.

## Scripts

| Script | Data | Hypothesis | Result | Analysis | Date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | | | |

## Conventions

- Name scripts `script_XX_brief_description.py`.
- Link the data access/provenance record and hypothesis.
- Capture complete output in `results/logs/`.
- Protect sensitive inputs and outputs explicitly.
- Compare transfer from synthetic or downloaded evidence when scientifically relevant.
- Record limitations that affect generalization or interpretation.
